transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this recovery huddle started. As we all know, P-4 went down during the morning shift and we have an urgent outbound order due at the end of the week. We have the manual palletizing station in the finished-goods warehouse available as a temporary alternative. Before I settle on a recovery plan, I need each functional owner to log their current finding as a named entry in the huddle log — maintenance, shipment staging, and safety controls. Let's hear from each of you.
